svg.text: Fig. 8 | Spatial-molecular systems architecture of spaceflight tropism and mechanotransduction.
Multiscale integration of subcellular mechanoperception, single-cell tissue activation (inflorescence stem_9 & root columella), and functional pathway cross-talk in Arabidopsis thaliana.
Plant statocyte & elongating vascular cambium site
• H⁺ extrusion by AHA1/2 lowers apoplast pH to ~4.8
• Low pH activates expansins (EXPA1/8) & XTH xyloglucanases
Key DEGs: XTH22 (+0.84 log₂FC, padj=1e-8) · EXPA1 (+0.62)
• RBOHD generates O₂•⁻ → CSD1 dismutates to H₂O₂
• Peroxidases regulate wall cross-linking & microgravity stress
Key DEGs: PRXIIB (+1.22 log₂FC) · CSD1 (+0.78) · CAT2 (-0.43)
• Cytosolic Ca²⁺ transients direct RABA1A/ARF1A1C polar targeting
• MPK3 (+0.88 log₂FC) coordinates the downstream stress cascade
ARF19 / ARF7 activate SAUR expansion genes
Heat Shock Factors (HSFs) trigger chaperone network
MPK3 / MPK6 MAP kinase regulatory pathway
• MDH1 (+0.63 log₂FC) Malate dehydrogenase TCA cycle
Single-cell deconvolution across Salk developmental atlas clusters (GSE226097)
Key Insight: Inflorescence stem vascular cambium (stem_9) mounts peak cell-wall loosening
Coupled with root tip columella Ca²⁺ signaling, defining the primary axis of microgravity gravitropic remodeling.
Sequential chronological cascade: microgravity perception to cellular stress adaptation
Amyloplasts lose 1g buoyant weight; freely float in statocytes without directional resting vector
Effectors: Statolith displacement · Amyloplast Brownian motion · Loss of steady pressure on distal ER
2. Stochastic MSL Channel Gating & Ca²⁺ Flux
Membrane tension fluctuations induce repetitive cytosolic Ca²⁺ pulses sensed by touch proteins
Effectors: MSL10 / MCA1 stretch-activated channels · TCH1/CAM2 (+1.28 log₂FC) · CPK1 phosphorylation
Endosomal vesicle recycling directs PIN carriers to lateral flanks instead of strict polar axes
Effectors: RABA1A (+0.74 log₂FC) & ARF1A1C (+0.59) endosomes · PIN2/3/7 lateralized redistribution
Asymmetric auxin accumulates in inflorescence stem cambium (stem_9) & root procambium
Effectors: stem_9 (+1.23% fraction, padj=0.003) · TIR1/AFB signalling · ARF19 transcriptional activation
PM H⁺-ATPase extrusion drops apoplast pH to ~4.8, triggering acid-growth enzyme cleavage
Effectors: AHA1/2 proton pumping · XTH22 (+0.84 log₂FC) · EXPA1 (+0.62 log₂FC) xyloglucan cleavage
Apoplastic ROS generation mitigated by mitochondrial bioenergetics and chaperone folding
Effectors: RBOHD ROS burst · PRXIIB (+1.22 log₂FC) · HSP70-1 (+1.45) · HSP90.1 (+1.18) · ATPA (+0.72)
